description: WRITES. Deletes one of the caller's own alerts by its id from get_my_alerts, freeing a slot of the 25 an account may hold. Needs confirm: true, and only when the user asked to remove that alert.

confirm.description: Must be true: deleting is the user's explicit request.

id.description: The alert's id, exactly as get_my_alerts lists it.

name: delete_my_alert
